title: Matt Nye - Playa Escalator (feat. Snoop Dogg)
htmlContent:
Matt Nye shared a new single called "Playa Escalator" featuring Snoop Dogg. The single "Playa Escalator" finds him reaching new lyrical heights, as he weaves sharply-crafted, crisp flows atop fuelled production.

Matt Nye delivers a series of smooth, cleverly written bars that make for a charismatic and gripping listen. Following up next, Snoop Dogg delivers addictive, melodically-tinged verses that provide a refreshing contrast with Matt Nye’s verses. Capped off by a catchy hook, “Playa Escalator” highlights Matt Nye’s powerful lyrical prowess and unique vocals.
